title: Clinical trial to compare the efficacy and safety of Buckberg versus Del Nido cardioplegia in isolated myocardial revascularization surgery
official: Randomized and open clinical trial to compare the efficacy and safety of Buckberg versus Del Nido cardioplegia in isolated myocardial revascularization surgery
summary: Main objective: The main objective of the study is to study the efficacy and safety in terms of myocardial protection in patients undergoing isolated myocardial revascularization surgery with extracorporeal circulation of two cardioplegic solutions: Del Nido cardioplegia versus Buckberg cardioplegia. For this purpose, levels of myocardial injury markers (CK and Troponin T) and in-hospital mortality will be compared between both strategies.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients of legal age (>18 years) of both sexes.
2. Patients undergoing isolated myocardial revascularization surgery with extracorporeal circulation.
3. Patients providing the informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Emergent surgery
2. Acute coronary syndrome with or without ST elevation in the last 48 hours.
3. Patient who rejects blood products
4. Patients with concomitant medical conditions that determine the need to use one or another cardioplegic solution; such as advanced chronic kidney disease, diabetes with poor glycemic control or significant preoperative anemia that requires hemodilution to be reduced as much as possible.
